content.help: Off: only the player is simulated; NPCs keep their bodies' rest shape.
How many of the nearest NPCs get physics at once. More costs frame time in crowded places. Until changed here, configs.json / userConfigs.json decide.
NPCs farther than this (game units; 2000 is about 28 m) aren't simulated.
NPCs out of the camera's view for a second stop being simulated (their bodies keep their shape) and resume when seen again. Saves frame time in crowds.
Physics for head parts that carry it: SMP hair, SMP Head.

content.text: A-Body: Penis Doesn't Collide With Legs
content.help: Workaround for a known FO4SMP issue: with A-Body's male SMP, contact between the penis and the legs can make the penis jitter or fly out. On: those two collision bodies ignore each other (everything else collides as A-Body intends). Turn off to test A-Body's collisions as authored.
Writes FO4SMP's diagnostics to My Games\Fallout4\F4SE\FO4SMP.log (every bone and constraint built, contact reports, repeated warnings). Turn on when reporting a problem; it makes the log much longer.
